definition: A person who fixes cars and machines.
examples: I took my car to the mechanic.
He works as a mechanic in a garage.
The mechanic said the brakes are fine.

spanish.definition: Persona que arregla carros y máquinas.

definition: A piece of clothing without sleeves that you wear over a shirt.
examples: He wore a gray vest with his suit.
Police officers wear a bulletproof vest.
Put on your life vest before we leave.

spanish.definition: Prenda sin mangas que se lleva sobre una camisa.

definition: Working well without wasting time or energy.
examples: This new heater is very efficient.
She's a fast and efficient worker.
We need a more efficient way to do this.

spanish.definition: Que funciona bien sin perder tiempo ni energía.

definition: A load of goods sent to a place.
examples: The shipment arrived this morning.
We're waiting for a shipment from China.
The company lost a large shipment.

spanish.definition: Carga de productos enviada a un lugar.

definition: Very famous and admired.
examples: He's a legendary guitar player.
The team's coach is legendary.
Her cooking is legendary in our family.

spanish.definition: Muy famoso y admirado.

definition: To find an answer to a problem.
examples: We need to resolve this problem today.
They resolved their differences.
The issue was resolved quickly.

spanish.definition: Encontrar la respuesta a un problema.

definition: Connected to machines.
examples: The plane had a mechanical problem.
He studied mechanical engineering.
It's an old mechanical clock.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con las máquinas.

definition: The money you pay for a trip on a bus, train, or taxi.
examples: The bus fare is two dollars.
How much is the taxi fare to the airport?
Train fares went up again.

spanish.definition: Dinero que pagas por un viaje en bus, tren o taxi.

definition: To make something longer or bigger.
examples: We decided to extend our vacation.
Can I extend the deadline?
The park extends all the way to the river.

spanish.definition: Hacer algo más largo o más grande.

definition: A leather seat for a horse or a bike.
examples: He put the saddle on the horse.
She climbed into the saddle.
The saddle on my bike is too high.

spanish.definition: Asiento de cuero para un caballo o una bicicleta.

definition: Made by people and not natural.
examples: This juice has artificial flavors.
We have an artificial Christmas tree.
Artificial intelligence is changing the world.

spanish.definition: Hecho por las personas y no natural.

definition: To do something successfully.
examples: We accomplished a lot today.
What do you want to accomplish this year?
She accomplished her goal.

spanish.definition: Hacer algo con éxito.

definition: The act of putting a dead body in the ground.
examples: The burial will be on Friday.
Her family went to the burial.
He wanted a simple burial near his home.

spanish.definition: Acto de poner un cadáver en la tierra.

definition: A punishment of staying at school after class; the state of being kept by the police.
examples: The teacher gave him detention.
She has detention after school.
He spent two days in detention.

spanish.definition: Castigo de quedarse en la escuela después de clase; estado de estar retenido por la policía.

definition: To cook food in an oven.
examples: My mom baked a cake for my birthday.
I love the smell of baking bread.
Bake the cookies for ten minutes.

spanish.definition: Cocinar comida en un horno.

definition: A sudden failure of a machine; a time of serious mental problems.
examples: We had a breakdown on the highway.
She had a nervous breakdown.
The breakdown of the bus made us late.

spanish.definition: Falla repentina de una máquina; momento de problemas mentales serios.

definition: A long formal dress; a loose piece of clothing worn in a hospital.
examples: She wore a beautiful white gown.
The nurse gave me a hospital gown.
Students wear a cap and gown at graduation.

spanish.definition: Vestido largo y formal; prenda suelta que se usa en un hospital.

definition: Land outside of cities, with farms and fields.
examples: We spent the weekend in the countryside.
The countryside is beautiful in the fall.
They bought a small house in the countryside.

spanish.definition: Tierra fuera de las ciudades, con granjas y prados.

definition: A large white bird with a long neck.
examples: Two swans were swimming on the lake.
The swan opened its wings.
We fed the swans at the park.

spanish.definition: Ave grande y blanca con cuello largo.

definition: The light that comes from the moon.
examples: We walked on the beach in the moonlight.
The lake was shining in the moonlight.
The moonlight came through the window.

spanish.definition: Luz que viene de la luna.

definition: An official paper that shows who you are.
examples: You need identification to enter.
May I see your identification, please?
A passport is a good form of identification.

spanish.definition: Documento oficial que muestra quién eres.

definition: To legally take a child into your family; to start to use something new.
examples: They adopted a baby girl from Colombia.
We want to adopt a dog.
The school adopted a new system.

spanish.definition: Tomar legalmente a un niño en tu familia; empezar a usar algo nuevo.

definition: Careful thought; caring about other people's feelings.
examples: After much consideration, I said yes.
Show some consideration for your neighbors.
Cost is the main consideration.

spanish.definition: Pensamiento cuidadoso; preocuparse por los sentimientos de otros.

definition: An operation that moves a body part from one person to another.
examples: She needs a heart transplant.
He had a kidney transplant last year.
The transplant saved his life.

spanish.definition: Operación que pasa una parte del cuerpo de una persona a otra.

definition: The sad feeling of being alone.
examples: Loneliness is common among old people.
He wrote about his loneliness in a letter.
Her dog helps with her loneliness.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento triste de estar solo.

definition: Very big, long, or exciting; a long story or movie.
examples: We went on an epic road trip.
That party was epic!
The movie is a three-hour epic.

spanish.definition: Muy grande, largo o emocionante; historia o película larga.

definition: A thin white layer of ice on cold surfaces.
examples: There was frost on the car this morning.
The frost killed my tomato plants.
I had to scrape the frost off the windows.

spanish.definition: Capa delgada y blanca de hielo sobre superficies frías.

definition: The act of putting a name on an official list; a paper that shows a car is registered.
examples: Registration opens on Monday.
Can I see your license and registration?
The registration fee is thirty dollars.

spanish.definition: Acto de poner un nombre en una lista oficial; documento que muestra que un carro está registrado.

definition: A mountain that can send out hot liquid rock and smoke.
examples: The volcano erupted last year.
We climbed a volcano in Hawaii.
There's a volcano near the town.

spanish.definition: Montaña que puede lanzar roca líquida caliente y humo.

definition: Not sharp; saying what you think in a direct way.
examples: This knife is too blunt.
Let me be blunt: I don't like your idea.
He was hit with a blunt object.

spanish.definition: Sin filo; que dice lo que piensa de forma directa.

definition: To ask an expert for advice.
examples: You should consult your doctor.
I consulted a lawyer about the contract.
She didn't consult anyone before she quit.

spanish.definition: Pedirle consejo a un experto.

definition: Even so.
examples: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
He was tired, but he finished the race nevertheless.
The job was hard. Nevertheless, she loved it.

spanish.definition: Aun así.

definition: A big public party with music, games, or rides.
examples: The kids had fun at the carnival.
We rode the Ferris wheel at the carnival.
Brazil is famous for its carnival.

spanish.definition: Gran fiesta pública con música, juegos o atracciones.

definition: A flat object for carrying food and drinks.
examples: The waiter brought the drinks on a tray.
She carried a tray of cookies.
Put your tray back when you finish your lunch.

spanish.definition: Objeto plano para llevar comida y bebidas.

definition: According to what people say, but maybe not true.
examples: This is supposedly the best pizza in town.
He's supposedly very rich.
The store is supposedly closing next month.

spanish.definition: Según lo que dice la gente, pero quizás no sea verdad.

definition: A feeling that something is true without proof.
examples: I have a hunch he's lying.
She followed her hunch and called the police.
It's only a hunch, but I think we'll win.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento de que algo es verdad sin tener prueba.

definition: A large, expensive boat used for fun.
examples: The millionaire owns a yacht.
They spent the summer on a yacht.
There are many yachts in the harbor.

spanish.definition: Barco grande y caro usado por diversión.

definition: A dirty mark that is hard to remove; to leave a dirty mark.
examples: There's a coffee stain on my shirt.
Red wine can stain the carpet.
This stain won't come out.

spanish.definition: Marca sucia difícil de quitar; dejar una marca sucia.

definition: Kind and thinking about what other people need.
examples: It was so thoughtful of you to call.
He's a thoughtful husband.
That's a thoughtful gift.

spanish.definition: Amable y que piensa en lo que otros necesitan.

definition: Covered with a lot of hair.
examples: He has very hairy arms.
Our dog is big and hairy.
That spider is so hairy!

spanish.definition: Cubierto de mucho pelo.

definition: To keep people interested and having fun; to have guests at your home.
examples: The clown entertained the kids.
They love to entertain on weekends.
This game will entertain you for hours.

spanish.definition: Mantener a la gente interesada y divertida; tener invitados en casa.

definition: Acting like a child in a bad way.
examples: Stop being so childish.
It was a childish thing to say.
His behavior was very childish.

spanish.definition: Que actúa como un niño de manera negativa.

definition: A contract to rent something; to rent something with a contract.
examples: We signed a one-year lease.
My lease ends in June.
They leased a new car.

spanish.definition: Contrato para alquilar algo; alquilar algo con un contrato.

definition: Likely to change or fall.
examples: That ladder looks unstable.
The country has an unstable government.
His moods are very unstable.

spanish.definition: Que probablemente va a cambiar o caer.

definition: The act of breaking a law or a rule.
examples: He got a ticket for a traffic violation.
This is a violation of the rules.
The company paid a fine for the violation.

spanish.definition: Acto de romper una ley o una regla.

definition: A stick that helps a person walk.
examples: My grandfather walks with a cane.
She needed a cane after the surgery.
The old man hit the floor with his cane.

spanish.definition: Palo que ayuda a una persona a caminar.

definition: An idea or belief.
examples: I have no notion of what he means.
That's a silly notion.
He had a notion that he could fix it himself.

spanish.definition: Idea o creencia.

definition: To make jokes about someone.
examples: My brothers always tease me.
Don't tease your sister about her hair.
I'm just teasing you!

spanish.definition: Hacer bromas sobre alguien.

definition: The final result of something.
examples: We're happy with the outcome.
Nobody knows the outcome of the election yet.
The outcome of the game surprised everyone.

spanish.definition: Resultado final de algo.

definition: To close something hard and with a loud noise.
examples: Please don't slam the door.
She slammed the phone down.
He got angry and slammed his hand on the table.

spanish.definition: Cerrar algo fuerte y con un ruido alto.

definition: An object used to hit the ball in tennis; a loud noise.
examples: I bought a new tennis racket.
What's that racket outside?
The kids are making a racket upstairs.

spanish.definition: Objeto usado para golpear la pelota en tenis; ruido fuerte.

definition: Unusual and from a faraway place.
examples: She loves exotic fruit.
They traveled to many exotic places.
The zoo has exotic birds.

spanish.definition: Poco común y de un lugar lejano.

definition: How big or important something is.
examples: We don't know the extent of the damage.
I agree with you to some extent.
To what extent is this true?

spanish.definition: Qué tan grande o importante es algo.

definition: A neat pile of things; to put things in a neat pile.
examples: There's a stack of books on my desk.
He stacked the chairs after the meeting.
Please stack the plates here.

spanish.definition: Montón ordenado de cosas; poner cosas en un montón ordenado.

definition: To make someone happy by giving them what they want.
examples: Nothing satisfies my boss.
A small salad won't satisfy me.
We work hard to satisfy our customers.

spanish.definition: Hacer feliz a alguien dándole lo que quiere.

definition: The act of leaving a place.
examples: Check the departure time on your ticket.
The flight's departure was delayed.
We said goodbye before her departure.

spanish.definition: Acto de irse de un lugar.

definition: To ride ocean waves on a board; to look at websites.
examples: He learned to surf in California.
I was surfing the internet all night.
She surfs every morning before work.

spanish.definition: Montar las olas del mar en una tabla; mirar sitios web.

definition: To make someone afraid.
examples: The loud noise frightened the baby.
Sorry, I didn't mean to frighten you.
Thunder frightens my dog.

spanish.definition: Hacer que alguien tenga miedo.

definition: Long, thin pasta.
examples: We had spaghetti for dinner.
I make spaghetti with meat sauce.
The kids love spaghetti.

spanish.definition: Pasta larga y delgada.

definition: A small hot pepper; a spicy dish of meat and beans.
examples: This sauce has a lot of chili in it.
My dad makes great chili.
We ate a big bowl of chili at the game.

spanish.definition: Pimiento pequeño y picante; plato picante de carne y frijoles.

definition: Not deep.
examples: The water here is very shallow.
Kids should stay in the shallow end of the pool.
He's a shallow person who only cares about money.

spanish.definition: Que no es profundo.

definition: A machine that makes electricity.
examples: The hospital has a generator for emergencies.
We used a generator when the power went out.
The generator is very loud.

spanish.definition: Máquina que produce electricidad.

definition: To open a knot or something that is tied.
examples: Can you untie this knot?
He untied his shoes.
She's untying the boat.

spanish.definition: Abrir un nudo o algo que está amarrado.

definition: Not real or honest; a person who pretends.
examples: He gave the police a phony name.
She has a phony smile.
That guy is a phony.

spanish.definition: Que no es real ni honesto; persona que finge.

definition: One of the seven large areas of land on Earth.
examples: Africa is a large continent.
She has visited every continent.
Asia is the biggest continent.

spanish.definition: Una de las siete grandes áreas de tierra del planeta.

definition: To plan something; to put things in order.
examples: We organized a party for her.
I need to organize my desk.
He's organizing a meeting for Friday.

spanish.definition: Planear algo; poner las cosas en orden.

definition: Making a lot of noise.
examples: Our neighbors are very noisy.
It's a noisy restaurant.
The old fan is too noisy.

spanish.definition: Que hace mucho ruido.

definition: The line where the sky seems to meet the land or the sea.
examples: The sun went down below the horizon.
We saw a ship on the horizon.
Travel opens your horizons.

spanish.definition: Línea donde el cielo parece juntarse con la tierra o el mar.

definition: An image you see in a mirror or in water; careful thought.
examples: She looked at her reflection in the mirror.
I saw the mountains' reflection in the lake.
After some reflection, he said no.

spanish.definition: Imagen que ves en un espejo o en el agua; pensamiento cuidadoso.

definition: A man who promises to help a child when the child is baptized.
examples: My uncle is my godfather.
He asked his brother to be the baby's godfather.
My godfather always sends me a birthday card.

spanish.definition: Hombre que promete ayudar a un niño cuando lo bautizan.

definition: A person who buys and sells things.
examples: He was a rich merchant.
The merchants sold silk and spices.
Local merchants closed their shops early.

spanish.definition: Persona que compra y vende cosas.

definition: A long, loose piece of clothing worn at home; a long formal piece of clothing.
examples: She put on her robe after her shower.
The judge wore a black robe.
He came to the door in his robe.

spanish.definition: Prenda larga y suelta que se usa en casa; prenda larga y formal.

definition: The middle part of your body, above your hips.
examples: He put his arm around her waist.
These pants are too big at the waist.
She wore a belt around her waist.

spanish.definition: Parte media del cuerpo, encima de las caderas.

definition: A sad feeling because something was not as good as you hoped.
examples: The movie was a big disappointment.
I could see the disappointment on his face.
To our disappointment, the game was canceled.

spanish.definition: Sentimiento triste porque algo no fue tan bueno como esperabas.

definition: A new business or project with some risk.
examples: Their new business venture failed.
It's a risky venture.
She put all her money into the venture.

spanish.definition: Negocio o proyecto nuevo con algo de riesgo.

definition: A spicy Indian dish with sauce.
examples: I ordered a chicken curry.
This curry is too hot for me.
We had curry and rice for dinner.

spanish.definition: Plato indio picante con salsa.

definition: The soft part of a bed.
examples: This mattress is too hard.
We bought a new mattress.
I hid the money under the mattress.

spanish.definition: Parte blanda de una cama.

definition: A piece of equipment for cooking food over fire; to cook food this way.
examples: Dad put the burgers on the grill.
We grilled some fish on the beach.
I'm grilling chicken tonight.

spanish.definition: Equipo para cocinar comida sobre el fuego; cocinar comida de esta manera.

definition: A person's job; the act of controlling a country by force.
examples: Please write your name and occupation.
Teaching is a good occupation.
The occupation of the city lasted four years.

spanish.definition: Trabajo de una persona; acto de controlar un país por la fuerza.

definition: The last time or date to finish something.
examples: The deadline is Friday at noon.
We missed the deadline.
I work best when I have a deadline.

spanish.definition: Último momento o fecha para terminar algo.

definition: A public show of art or objects; to show something in public.
examples: We saw a new exhibit at the museum.
She'll exhibit her paintings in May.
The exhibit is about dinosaurs.

spanish.definition: Muestra pública de arte u objetos; mostrar algo en público.

definition: The front part of your leg below the knee.
examples: The ball hit him on the shin.
She has a bruise on her shin.
Soccer players protect their shins.

spanish.definition: Parte delantera de la pierna debajo de la rodilla.

definition: To say what a word means; to show exactly what something is.
examples: How do you define success?
The dictionary defines this word clearly.
Your job doesn't define you.

spanish.definition: Decir qué significa una palabra; mostrar exactamente qué es algo.

definition: Connected to the face; a beauty treatment for the face.
examples: He has facial hair now.
I couldn't read her facial expression.
She got a facial at the spa.

spanish.definition: Relacionado con la cara; tratamiento de belleza para la cara.

definition: To say no to something.
examples: The bank rejected my application.
They rejected our offer.
She was afraid he would reject her.

spanish.definition: Decirle que no a algo.

definition: To press skin hard between your fingers; a very small amount.
examples: Stop pinching me!
Add a pinch of salt.
She pinched the baby's cheek.

spanish.definition: Apretar fuerte la piel entre los dedos; cantidad muy pequeña.

definition: A very strong storm with fast winds.
examples: The hurricane hit Florida last night.
Many homes were destroyed in the hurricane.
Hurricane season starts in June.

spanish.definition: Tormenta muy fuerte con vientos rápidos.

definition: A very long, expensive car.
examples: We rented a limo for prom.
A limo was waiting outside the hotel.
The star got out of the limo.

spanish.definition: Carro muy largo y caro.

definition: To leave a dangerous place, or to move people out of it.
examples: We had to evacuate the building.
They evacuated the town before the storm.
Police are evacuating the area.

spanish.definition: Salir de un lugar peligroso, o sacar a la gente de él.

definition: To print and sell a book, or to put something online for people to read.
examples: She published her first novel last year.
The newspaper published the story.
He publishes a blog every week.

spanish.definition: Imprimir y vender un libro, o poner algo en línea para que la gente lo lea.

definition: To say what will happen in the future.
examples: Nobody can predict the future.
They're predicting snow for tomorrow.
He predicted that we would win.

spanish.definition: Decir qué va a pasar en el futuro.

definition: To face a difficult person or problem directly.
examples: She confronted him about the money.
You have to confront your fears.
I'm scared to confront my boss.

spanish.definition: Encarar directamente a una persona o un problema difícil.

definition: At a greater distance.
examples: The hotel is farther than I thought.
I can't walk any farther.
They moved farther from the city.

spanish.definition: A una mayor distancia.

definition: A large brown fruit with white food inside and a hard shell.
examples: We drank coconut water on the beach.
She made a coconut cake.
A coconut fell from the tree.

spanish.definition: Fruta grande y marrón con cáscara dura y pulpa blanca.

definition: A store that sells food; (in plural) the food you buy.
examples: I'm going to the grocery store.
Can you help me carry the groceries?
Groceries are so expensive now.

spanish.definition: Tienda que vende comida; (en plural) la comida que compras.

definition: A building at an airport or a bus station; causing death.
examples: Our flight leaves from Terminal 2.
He has terminal cancer.
We waited in the bus terminal.

spanish.definition: Edificio en un aeropuerto o estación de bus; que causa la muerte.

definition: To slowly lose color or become weaker.
examples: The sun made the curtains fade.
Her smile faded.
The sound of the music faded away.

spanish.definition: Perder color poco a poco o volverse más débil.

definition: A public show of art or other things.
examples: We went to an art exhibition.
The exhibition opens on Saturday.
The museum has a photo exhibition.

spanish.definition: Muestra pública de arte u otras cosas.

definition: A large store that sells food and things for the home.
examples: I bought milk at the supermarket.
The supermarket closes at ten.
There's a new supermarket near my house.

spanish.definition: Tienda grande que vende comida y cosas para la casa.

definition: A long brush for cleaning floors.
examples: Get the broom and clean the kitchen floor.
There's a broom behind the door.
She swept the leaves with a broom.

spanish.definition: Cepillo largo para limpiar pisos.
